consequence.statement: Issuing of certificates via DNS01 challenges on Cloudflare, which had been broken by a breaking change to the Cloudflare API, works again after upgrading to cert-manager 1.18.0.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading to 1.18.0, verify that Cloudflare DNS01 challenges complete and affected certificates issue and renew successfully; no configuration change is stated as required.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes the issuing of certificates via DNS01 challenges on Cloudflare, which had been broken by a breaking change to the Cloudflare API.

decision.reason: [ev-b8d6f16e3c8c] lists this under Bug or Regression. It says 1.18.0 fixes certificate issuance through Cloudflare DNS01 challenges after a breaking change to the Cloudflare API. It does not say anything fails, is rejected or needs an operator step after upgrading, so no failure kind is supported. Issuance changes from broken to working, so behavior-change (review-required) fits, along with a remediation to check that Cloudflare DNS01 challenges complete. Confidence is low because the evidence does not say how the fix changes runtime behaviour, so "none" is also arguable.
